hero.h1: Home Remodeling Oklahoma City: Faux, Paint and Repairs
hero.subheadline: Hyde Studio is Landon's family business, bringing faux finishes to the OKC area along with painting, cabinet refinishing, repairs and kitchen and bath remodels.

image.alt: Two-story house with white exterior, gray roof and stone accents, from home remodeling Oklahoma City company Hyde Studio

intro.h2: Facelifts for homes with good bones
paragraphs: Hyde Studio offers home remodeling Oklahoma City homeowners can start small with. In the family's own words, they are introducing faux to the OKC area, facelifting homes and bringing life to lifeless bones. A job can be as simple as new light fixtures or as big as a kitchen or bathroom remodel.

Landon, the owner and operator, does the work himself. One client had him paint the interior of a 2,500 square foot home, refinish the kitchen cabinets, replace a toilet and repair a shed. Another had a fence built from scratch rather than from premade panels. Reviewers mention fair prices and arriving on time.

items.name: Kitchen and bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Hyde Studio takes on kitchen and bathroom remodels as well as smaller updates. Tell Landon what you want to change, from a dated vanity to a whole kitchen, and he will walk through what the job involves and what it costs.

items.name: Cabinet refinishing
items.blurb: Kitchen cabinets that are solid but tired can be refinished instead of replaced. Landon has refinished kitchen cabinets for clients as part of a larger refresh, alongside interior painting, so the whole kitchen looks updated without a full tear-out.

items.name: Faux finishes and painting
items.blurb: Faux finishing is what Hyde Studio set out to bring to the OKC area. Add painting and staining, including whole-house interiors like a 2,500 square foot home, and you have one family business for the walls, trim and cabinets in your home.

image.alt: Two-story house with white painted exterior, dark roof, arched entry and two garage doors

items.name: Staining and trim
items.blurb: Wood doors, trim and baseboards can be stained to bring warmth back to a room. One home shows deep brown stained trim, a frosted glass pantry door and a tile floor with dark wood inlay strips running through the hallway.

image.alt: Hallway with dark stained pantry door with etched glass, matching trim, light walls and tile floor with wood inlay

items.name: Repairs and fixture swaps
items.blurb: Small jobs count too. Landon has replaced a toilet, repaired a shed, changed light fixtures, hung Christmas lights and even helped update an RV, reupholstering its window valances. Bundle a list of fixes into one visit.

items.name: Custom-built wood fences
items.blurb: Landon builds wood fences from scratch instead of using premade panels. A recent client said her new fence looks perfect and is very sturdy. The picket tops and straight runs show the care that goes into a hand-built fence.

image.alt: New wood privacy fence with dog-ear pickets running along a grassy side yard

items.title: The owner does the work
items.text: Landon is the owner and operator, and he is the one who shows up. One client said they had to encourage him to stop and take a break.

items.title: Builds things the long way
items.text: His fences are built from scratch, not from premade panels, and a client called the result perfect and very sturdy. The same approach carries into paint, stain and cabinet work.

items.title: On time and fairly priced
items.text: Reviewers mention on-time arrival, on-time finishing and very fair prices. Every review on Hyde Studio's Google profile so far is five stars, from fences to faux work.

items.title: One call for many jobs
items.text: Painting, faux finishes, cabinet refinishing, repairs, fences and remodels. One family has used Hyde Studio for a whole house of projects and trusts Landon in their home.

about.h2: Meet Landon and the Hyde family
about.text: Hyde Studio is a family business in the Oklahoma City area, owned and operated by Landon. The family set out to introduce faux finishes to OKC and to give tired homes a facelift, from changing lights and painting to staining, repairs and full kitchen and bathroom remodels. Clients describe Landon as honest, reliable and detail-oriented, and say he genuinely cares about doing things the right way. When he shows up, he works. That is why one family keeps calling him back, from interior painting and cabinets to a shed and a fence.

process.h2: How a project with Hyde Studio works

steps.title: Call with your list
steps.text: Call (405) 551-5386 and describe the project, or the list of projects. Small fixes and big remodels are both welcome.

steps.title: Walk the house
steps.text: Landon looks at the rooms, surfaces or fence line, talks through finishes and options, and gives you a price.

steps.title: Do the work
steps.text: Landon arrives when he says he will and works through the job, whether that is faux finishing, paint, cabinets or a remodel.

steps.title: Walk it together
steps.text: Look over the finished work with Landon and point out anything you want touched up before the job is closed out.

items.name: Andrew C.
items.text:
Landon, the owner and operator of Hyde Studio, has done a wide variety of work for us, and I can’t recommend him highly enough. He’s helped with everything from painting the interior of our 2,500-square-foot home and refinishing our kitchen cabinets to replacing a toilet, repairing our shed, hanging Christmas lights, and helping repair and update an RV, including reupholstering the window valances.

What stands out most about Landon is his character and work ethic. He is a man of faith and conviction, and that shows in the way he conducts himself and the pride he takes in his workmanship. He is honest, trustworthy, reliable, detail-oriented, and genuinely cares about doing things the right way.

When Landon shows up, he works. I’ve actually had to encourage him to stop and take a break because he works so hard. That kind of dedication is rare these days, and it shows in the finished product.

He’s extremely versatile and has consistently done excellent work for us. I trust Landon in my home and with my family, and I would recommend Hyde Studio without hesitation for painting, handyman work, repairs, remodeling, or just about any project he takes on.

items.name: Angela S.
items.text: Landon recently built a new fence for me. He doesn’t use the premade fence panels, he builds the fence from scratch!! It looks perfect and it is very sturdy!!

items.name: Art H.
items.text: Hyde Studio painting, repair and faux services are outstanding. Beautiful workmanship, on-time arriving and on-time finishing the job. The prices are very fair. These guys are amazing!! Thank you.

service_area.text: Hyde Studio works in the Oklahoma City area, the region named in the family's own Facebook post about bringing faux finishes to OKC. Google does not list a street address or a set service area, so call (405) 551-5386 with your neighborhood or town. Landon will tell you whether your project fits his schedule, including Saturday and early Friday appointments.

items.q: What kinds of jobs do you take?
items.a: A wide range: kitchen and bathroom remodels, cabinet refinishing, faux finishes, interior painting, staining, light fixture changes, repairs like a toilet replacement or a shed, and custom-built wood fences. One client has used Hyde Studio for painting, handyman work, repairs and remodeling.

A faux finish is a decorative paint technique that gives a wall or surface a look of its own, beyond a flat coat of paint. Hyde Studio set out to bring faux finishes to the OKC area. Call Landon to talk about where one would work in your home.

items.q: Who will actually do the work?
items.a: Landon, the owner and operator. Reviewers name him directly and describe him as honest, reliable and detail-oriented. One client said he works so hard they had to encourage him to take a break. Hyde Studio is a family business, so you deal with the owner.
Monday to Thursday 9 AM to 6 PM, Friday 7 AM to 6 PM and Saturday 9 AM to 6 PM. Hyde Studio is closed on Sunday. Saturday hours make it easier to meet if you work during the week.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Call (405) 551-5386 and describe the project. Landon will look at the space and give you a price. Reviewers describe the prices as very fair and say jobs start and finish on time. If you have several small jobs, list them all so they can be done together.

final_cta.text: Call Landon to talk through paint, faux, cabinets or a remodel.
